# Charter — S03 Domain and schema (retrospective, 2026-11-21)

- **Project:** S03 'Domain and schema — aggregates, state machines, baseline domain migration', track v1, ADM phase G, delivery plateau, tranche 2, project `01a1d039-0d28-743b-86c7-0d0698ed69c1`, plan `docs/plans/slices/S03-domain-schema.md`. The repository's public source snapshot commit `96a3d47b0e43ef871ae42c0bfafac6a677f7a418` (2026-11-12T22:38:46+01:00), subject 'conveyor: public source snapshot (2026-11-12)', carries the slice: `migrations/0002_domain.sql` (459 lines, 14 tables, 14 FORCE RLS policies), `crates/domain/src/board.rs` (629 lines) and `crates/store/tests/claim_race.rs` (134 lines). No dedicated S03 feature commit and no linked issue exist — the project row records `meta.issues: []` and its plan frontmatter still reads `status: planned`. This charter is written by the 2026-11-21 retrospective rework under the standing delegation `01a1ff1f-e4ba-72dc-9c1a-13049933cf14` (the published decision 'Standing delegation extension — the U5 programme rework (2026-11-21)'); it does not attest contemporaneous intent.
- **Mandate:** give the conveyor one stored domain behind every later slice — fourteen aggregates as total Rust functions, one baseline migration that owns the tables, indexes, partial uniques and row-level security, and one refusal vocabulary — so that a Rust case statement, a store transaction, an action and the database all refuse the same transition, and no later slice invents a table.
- **Scope:** SPEC §5.3, §6, §8 S3 and §11 R8/R10; `migrations/0002_domain.sql` — programme, project, board, list, card_type, card, run, approval, approval_decision, governed_asset, trace_link, catalogue_entry, revision and andon_state; the `may_move` matrix and the run, approval and asset state machines; the store modules taking `TenantId` under `_tx`; and the `catalogue_entry.kind` vocabulary with the delivery matrix as one `project_type` row. Out of scope: every route and action (S04–S06), the board satellites label/comment/task/custom_field/board_membership/webhook (S05), channels and delivery (S06), outlines, quality and project_request (S07), models, views and portfolio registers (S08), documents, repositories and secrets (S09), conversations (S10), procedures (S11), workflow (S13), and the capability columns of S15.
- **Expected outputs:** `project-brief`, `evidence`. **Closure outputs:** `closure-review`.
- **Deliverables:** the fourteen tenant-scoped tables with ENABLE and FORCE RLS and the `tenant_isolation` policy; `card`'s claim columns and the paired-null CHECK; the partial uniques `uq_run_live` and `uq_appr_pending`; the four gate properties (a) archive invariant, (b) claim exclusivity, (c) one pending approval per (run, gate), (d) terminal-run and revision invariants; the RLS proof; and the schema review against data-arch §2.3/§2.4.
- **Acceptance:** the SPEC §8 S3 gate — 'proptest on transitions; schema review' — with each clause carried by a named real-Postgres test or proptest, and the slice plan §7's seven-command gate. The rework's acceptance instrument is `acceptance/programme/S03.toml`; the project re-closes through the one gate decided by an approver other than its requester, on the P0-only gate.
- **Tranche and governance:** tranche 2 `01a1e9e0-e2ac-786b-ac48-3b8bcdf12188` is `planned` at the 2026-11-21T19:24:46Z rework snapshot: created 2026-11-17T14:19:51Z, `authorised_at` null, `authorisation_review_id` null; its exit criteria name S03 and T2 and require a review recording continue, pause or stop. The project row reached `closed` at 2026-11-21T01:05:32Z and the register records the out-of-sequence closure as the accepted P0 issue `U3-EXC-S03` (`01a1fbac-8ec9-717c-be79-6d1b97980743`): 'Closed in an unauthorised tranche before the tranche review; accepted by the delegate as a retrospective exception under the standing delegation. The project is reworked in its batch and re-closed through the gates.' The contemporaneous record is the published evidence document `01a1e686-d031-739d-ac30-9c0d4d8edffb` (2026-11-16T22:42:37Z, measured at main@cc88052), which inventories 0/0 actions, 2/2 modules and 14/14 tables and states that it does not re-run the acceptance suite. No contemporaneous charter, Statement of Architecture Work, delivery contract, Phase-G review or closure review was authored; this set is retrospective.

soaw.title: Statement of Architecture Work — S03 Domain and schema (retrospective, 2026-11-21)

body.assignment: Rework the V1 slice S03 (SPEC §6, §8 S3) by the reconstituted TOGAF/MSP lifecycle: produce and publish the seven mandatory Phase A–D artefacts, the charter and the delivery contract, take the project baseline with the one WBS deliverable, record the Phase-G compliance review, publish the project's expected outputs (`project-brief`, `evidence`) and the closure review, and re-close through the one gate on the P0-only gate.
body.scope: the baseline domain of SPEC §5.3 and §6: the fourteen tables of migrations/0002_domain.sql (programme, project, board, list, card_type, card, run, approval, approval_decision, governed_asset, trace_link, catalogue_entry, revision, andon_state), the may_move matrix and the run/approval/asset state machines, the store `_tx` modules with TenantId, and the catalogue_entry.kind vocabulary. Out of scope: every route and action (S04–S06), the board satellites (S05), channels and delivery (S06), outlines, quality and project_request (S07), models, views and portfolio registers (S08), documents and secrets (S09), conversations (S10), procedures (S11), workflow (S13) and the capability columns (S15).
body.acceptance_criteria: The SPEC §8 S3 gate: proptest on transitions and schema review. Property (a) — no transition leaves list.kind and archived_at contradictory, proved by board.rs::archived_implies_the_card_sits_in_an_archive_list and ::restore_off_a_non_archive_list_is_an_error. Property (b) — claim not granted twice without release or expiry, proved as tested by claim_race.rs::thirty_two_racers_get_exactly_one_grant_and_the_fence_is_monotonic, with the lease-exclusivity half recorded as the P1 package v1-s03-1. Property (c) — one pending approval per (run, gate), proved by approval_race.rs::sixteen_racers_create_exactly_one_pending_approval. Property (d) — terminal run and dense revision, proved by transitions.rs::a_terminal_run_rejects_every_transition_and_a_revision_is_dense. Tenant isolation is proved by rls_domain.rs::the_fourteen_domain_tables_isolate_runtime_owner_and_superuser. The schema review against data-arch §2.3/§2.4 admits the P2 package v1-s03-2. The rework's acceptance instrument is acceptance/programme/S03.toml; the closure gate is decided by an approver other than its requester.

## Metadata

## Entries

Eight stakeholders on the influence/interest/engagement axes: the sponsoring group decides, the SRO is accountable, the programme architect is responsible, the Architecture Board approves, the schema reviewer and the S04–S06 teams are consulted, later slices and tenants are informed.

## Links

## Document

The artefact sits under the slice plan `docs/plans/slices/S03-domain-schema.md` and the project's architecture set; the published evidence record is document 01a1e686-d031-739d-ac30-9c0d4d8edffb.

artifacts.title: Driver/Goal/Objective Catalog — S03 Domain and schema (Phase A)

links.to: Requirements Catalog — S03 Domain and schema (Phase A)

artifacts.purpose: The drivers behind the baseline domain, the goal each serves and the objective the migration and the machines install.
artifacts.scope: one migration, list-as-state, claim and lease, approval uniqueness, FORCE RLS, the anti-accretion rule and the archive invariant.

entries.axis_a: D1 Fourteen aggregates with no single owning schema
entries.axis_b: G1 One baseline migration owns the tables

value.objective: migrations/0002_domain.sql creates exactly 14 tables (programme, project, board, list, card_type, card, run, approval, approval_decision, governed_asset, trace_link, catalogue_entry, revision, andon_state); `grep -c 'CREATE TABLE'` returns 14; later slices add tables but never re-invent one (S3 mandate; plan §1).

entries.axis_a: D2 A card carries its own status column, which drifts from its list
entries.axis_b: G2 list.kind is the only state

value.objective: `card` has no state or status column; `information_schema.columns` for card and (state,status) returns zero rows; `may_move` reads project_type.meta.matrix and an absent entry, card type or row denies (S3-D1, S3-D3; plan trap 1).

entries.axis_a: D3 Two claims can grant the same card
entries.axis_b: G3 A conditional claim UPDATE with a fence

value.objective: claim_card_tx is one `UPDATE … WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND id = $2 AND version = $5 AND (lease_expires_at IS NULL OR lease_expires_at < now() OR assignee_id = $3) RETURNING claim_fence, version`; claim_fence rises on every grant and release is fenced. The lease arm also lets the current assignee renew, so the exclusive reading is the P1 package v1-s03-1.

entries.axis_a: D4 Two pending approvals per (run, gate)
entries.axis_b: G4 A partial unique index is the guarantee

value.objective: uq_appr_pending (tenant_id, run_id, gate) WHERE status='pending'; a duplicate is 23505 and maps to ApprovalConflict; sixteen concurrent inserts yield one pending row. A NULL run_id escapes the index; the card-level path is S06's (plan trap 5).

entries.axis_a: D5 ENABLE RLS still lets the table owner read everything
entries.axis_b: G5 FORCE RLS on all fourteen tables

value.objective: every table carries tenant_id, ENABLE and FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY and the tenant_isolation policy; as conveyor_runtime scoped to A, B's rows are absent and a forged tenant_id=B insert fails WITH CHECK; the owner sees 0 and a superuser both (plan trap 7).

entries.axis_a: D6 Porting fr's 224-migration accretion is the largest failure mode
entries.axis_b: G6 The baseline is SPEC §6, not fr's history

value.objective: R10: a column enters only because §2.3/§2.4 names it; a deviation is a contract change; the schema-review step checks every table line by line and records a reviewed list rather than a silent drift (plan trap 10).

entries.axis_a: D7 Archive has two notions — a lane and a stamp — that can disagree

value.objective: archived_at IS NOT NULL implies list.kind='archive', proved by board.rs::archived_implies_the_card_sits_in_an_archive_list; restore off a non-archive list is an error. The stronger claim that every hot index filters archived cards is true only of the two board-scan indexes — the P2 package v1-s03-2.

entries.axis_b: No transition leaves list.kind and archived_at contradictory

value.acceptance: proptest ≥256 cases: archived_at.is_some() implies from_kind == Archive; restore off a non-archive list is Err. crates/domain/src/board.rs::archived_implies_the_card_sits_in_an_archive_list and ::restore_off_a_non_archive_list_is_an_error.

value.acceptance: crates/store/tests/claim_race.rs::thirty_two_racers_get_exactly_one_grant_and_the_fence_is_monotonic — exactly one Some, fence 1 then monotonic renewals, stale-fence completion writes nothing. Admitted limit (v1-s03-1): all 32 racers share seed.user and Version::INITIAL, so the version predicate decides the winner and the test would pass with the lease arm deleted.
approval_race.rs::sixteen_racers_create_exactly_one_pending_approval — one Ok, fifteen ApprovalConflict, pending count 1; uq_appr_pending is the guarantee.

transitions.rs::a_terminal_run_rejects_every_transition_and_a_revision_is_dense — a terminal run rejects every transition; revision seq is dense from 1; is_prunable('model') is true past 50 and false for 'requirement' at any depth.

entries.axis_b: All fourteen tables isolate runtime, owner and superuser

value.acceptance: rls_domain.rs::the_fourteen_domain_tables_isolate_runtime_owner_and_superuser — runtime scoped to A sees none of B's rows; a forged tenant_id=B insert fails WITH CHECK; owner 0; superuser both.

entries.axis_b: Two migrations, one embedded set, no IF NOT EXISTS

value.acceptance: fresh database applies 2; the second `cargo run -p conveyor-server -- migrate` exits 0 with _sqlx_migrations unchanged; store/src/migrate.rs asserts [(1,"platform"),(2,"domain")]; no `IF NOT EXISTS` in the file.

entries.axis_b: A card has no state or status column

value.acceptance: information_schema.columns for card and column_name in ('state','status') returns zero rows; an insta snapshot pins Card's field set; the plan's word-boundary grep returns 0.
`grep -c 'FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY' migrations/0002_domain.sql` returns 14; every policy is FOR ALL USING (tenant_id = app_current_tenant()) WITH CHECK (the same).

entries.axis_b: Eleven kinds and one delivery matrix row

value.acceptance: catalogue_entry.kind has no CHECK by design; S03 fixes the eleven labels (project_type, phase, recipe, wip_limit, gate, capability, deliverable_kind, milestone_kind, priority_level, board_template, architecture_standard); the delivery matrix is one project_type row with code='delivery' and meta.matrix (S3-D1).

entries.axis_b: A second reader checks 14 tables against §2.3/§2.4

value.acceptance: a line-by-line review yielding 14 tables with zero deviations or a reviewed list. No contemporaneous review record exists; this retrospective review re-performs the check and admits v1-s03-2 (the archive-exclusion claim covers only the two board-scan indexes).

entries.axis_b: A move keeps the boards in agreement and refuses a stale version

value.acceptance: transitions.rs::a_move_keeps_the_boards_in_agreement_and_refuses_a_stale_version — card.board_id equals list.board_id in the same statement; a move from a stale version is refused (plan trap 8).

Type catalog; phase D; plateau hld; owner the programme architect (conveyor-e2e); reviewer the Architecture Board; review date 2026-11-21; project 01a1d039-0d28-743b-86c7-0d0698ed69c1; retrospective under delegation 01a1ff1f-e4ba-72dc-9c1a-13049933cf14.

## Entries

Ten standards: Postgres 18 FORCE RLS, text+CHECK enumeration, the partial-index guarantee, UTC lease time, numeric positions, the `_tx` convention, the embedded forward-only migration set, the error vocabulary, the pure domain crate and the verification route.

## Links

Derives from the slice plan §5–§8 and data-arch §1.8; realizes the Phase D standards view; reuses the repository's delivery contract and the GitHub-hosted preflight.

## Document

The artefact sits under the slice plan; the standards are exercised by migrations/0002_domain.sql and the store test suite, and the gate is recorded in acceptance/programme/S03.toml.

risk.title: The lease-exclusivity claim is not exercised by the 32-racer test (v1-s03-1)
risk.body: claim_card_tx lets the same assignee re-claim an unexpired lease through its third arm (OR assignee_id = $3), and the 32-racer test shares seed.user and Version::INITIAL, so the version predicate decides the winner and the test would pass with the lease arm deleted. Property (b) is therefore overstated for the lease half.

risk.title: The archive-exclusion claim covers only the two board-scan indexes (v1-s03-2)
risk.body: Only card_board_list_position_idx and card_board_position_idx carry WHERE archived_at IS NULL; card_assignee_lease_idx and card_tsv_idx include stamped cards, and the later card_name_trgm_idx and card_wbs_node_idx add no predicate. A later slice inheriting the schema could read the claim as absolute.

issue.title: S03 closed out of sequence before the tranche-2 review (U3-EXC-S03)
issue.body: The project row reached closed at 2026-11-21T01:05:32Z in an unauthorised tranche before the tranche review; the delegate accepted it as a retrospective exception under the standing delegation, and this rework re-closes the project through the one gate.

issue.title: No contemporaneous schema review or Phase A-D artefact set existed at the snapshot
issue.body: The plan requires a second reader over data-arch §2.3/§2.4 and the mandatory artefacts; none existed at the 2026-11-21T19:24:46Z snapshot. This retrospective batch authors the seven artefacts and re-performs the review, admitting two packages.

assumption.title: S02's platform primitives stay stable under the domain
assumption.body: 0001_platform.sql, begin_scoped, the conveyor_runtime role and domain::{TenantId, Id, Version} are the base the fourteen tables and the tenant_isolation policy stand on; a change to the runtime role or to app_current_tenant() would invalidate the RLS proof.

assumption.title: Postgres 18 enforces FORCE RLS for the owner and scopes the runtime role
assumption.body: The RLS proof assumes the runtime role is scoped to one tenant per transaction and that ENABLE plus FORCE leaves the table owner with zero rows under the app_current_tenant() policy; rls_domain.rs checks runtime, owner and superuser.

dependency.title: S02 platform migration and tenancy primitives land first
dependency.body: S03 is blocked by S02: migrations/0002_domain.sql builds on 0001_platform.sql, begin_scoped, the conveyor_runtime role and TenantId, Id and Version.

dependency.title: Later slices add tables and never re-invent one
dependency.body: S04–S13 register actions, board satellites, channels, outlines and workflow over these fourteen tables and may add tables, but the baseline domain, the may_move matrix and the catalogue vocabulary are inherited, not replaced.

benefit.title: One stored domain behind every later slice
benefit.body: Fourteen tenant-isolated tables in one baseline migration mean a later slice reaches for an existing table instead of inventing one, and the anti-accretion rule (R10) keeps fr's 224-migration history out of the baseline.

benefit.title: The database and Rust refuse the same transition
benefit.body: The may_move matrix, the run, approval and asset state machines and the partial uniques give one refusal vocabulary: a terminal run rejects every transition, one pending approval exists per (run, gate), and a claim is granted once per version.

# Project brief — S03 Domain and schema (retrospective, 2026-11-21)

## Outcome

The conveyor has one stored domain: fourteen tenant-isolated tables created by `migrations/0002_domain.sql`, Rust state machines that refuse the same transitions the database refuses, a claim primitive with a monotonic fence, one pending approval per (run, gate), and one catalogue vocabulary for the flows every later slice builds on.

## Boundary

S03 owns the tables, the machines, the store `_tx` functions and the baseline migration. Every route and action is out (S04–S06); board satellites (labels, comments, tasks, custom fields, memberships, webhooks) are S05; channels and delivery are S06; outlines, quality and project_request are S07; models, views and portfolio registers S08; documents, repositories and secrets S09; conversations S10; procedures S11; workflow S13; capability columns S15. The run tree is later than `0002`: the 2026-11-09 amendment rebuilds it in `0037_run_tree_workflow_step.sql`, and `run.procedure_id` and `run.capability_id` never land here.

## Reuse sources

- `agent@83b8de7` — `crates/agent-api/src/{lease,tenancy}.rs` and `migrations/0190_b8_worker_lease.sql`: the conditional `UPDATE … RETURNING`, the paired-null CHECK and the tx-local `set_config` behind `begin_scoped`.
- `strata_rag@b9426c3` `store_providers.rs`: the `put_store_providers_tx` convention that becomes the store's `_tx` functions.
- `fr@6f7c509` `100_card_phase_lease.sql` §3.4 and the card satellites: the closed-degradation argument and the sprawl to avoid — not the lease table.
- S02: `0001_platform.sql` (11 tables), `begin_scoped`, the `conveyor_runtime` role and `domain::{TenantId, Id, Version}`.

## Inception units

The published evidence document `01a1e686-d031-739d-ac30-9c0d4d8edffb` (2026-11-16T22:42:37Z, measured at main@cc88052, generated by `scripts/build-coverage.py`) records 0/0 actions, 2/2 modules and 14/14 tables and states that it does not re-run the acceptance suite. No inception analysis or architecture design document for S03 exists in the snapshot; the plan's decisions S3-D1 to S3-D5 are the design record.

## Dependencies

- blocked-by: S02 — the platform migration, the runtime role, `begin_scoped` and `TenantId`/`Id`/`Version`.
- blocks: S04 (action registry) and S05/S06 (board and control plane) register over these tables; S07–S13 add tables and never re-invent these.
- related: the tranche-2 sibling T2 (decision ladder).

## Acceptance

The SPEC §8 S3 gate — 'proptest on transitions; schema review'. The plan §7 gate runs `cargo test -p conveyor-domain`, `cargo test -p conveyor-store`, migrates twice, asserts at least two migrations, zero `card` state/status columns and 14 FORCE RLS policies. The four gate properties are (a) the archive invariant, (b) claim exclusivity, (c) one pending approval per (run, gate), and (d) the terminal-run and revision invariants. Each has a named test; the rework's acceptance instrument is `acceptance/programme/S03.toml`.

## Capabilities

Tenant-isolated domain persistence; claim and lease discipline; approval dual control; run and card state machines; asset governance and revisions; the catalogue vocabulary and the delivery matrix; migration discipline. The schema review and the absolute archive-exclusion claim are recorded as partial (packages v1-s03-1 and v1-s03-2).

## Plan

Held to `docs/plans/slices/S03-domain-schema.md` — the plan frontmatter still reads `status: planned` and the project row echoes `meta.plan_status: "planned"` although `meta.measured_status` is `built`. Delivered in the public source snapshot `96a3d47b` (2026-11-12); reworked retrospectively on 2026-11-21.

# Closure review — S03 Domain and schema (retrospective, 2026-11-21)

## Outcome vs acceptance

The SPEC §8 S3 gate, clause by clause:

- **Proptest on transitions (property a).** Pass. `board.rs::archived_implies_the_card_sits_in_an_archive_list` and `::restore_off_a_non_archive_list_is_an_error`: `archived_at.is_some()` implies the card sits in an archive list; restore off a non-archive list is `Err`.
- **Claim (property b).** Pass as tested, with the P1 package recorded. `claim_race.rs::thirty_two_racers_get_exactly_one_grant_and_the_fence_is_monotonic` produces exactly one grant, fence 1 then strictly increasing renewals, and a stale-fence completion writes nothing. The lease-exclusivity half is not exercised: all 32 racers use `seed.user` and `Version::INITIAL`, and `claim_card_tx` lets the same assignee re-claim an unexpired lease, so the test would pass with the lease arm deleted (v1-s03-1, P1).
- **One pending approval per (run, gate) (property c).** Pass. `approval_race.rs::sixteen_racers_create_exactly_one_pending_approval` — one `Ok`, fifteen `ApprovalConflict`, pending count 1; the partial unique `uq_appr_pending` is the guarantee, and `dual_control_needs_two_distinct_approvers_and_one_decision_each` adds the two-approver rule.
- **Terminal-run and revision invariants (property d).** Pass. `transitions.rs::a_terminal_run_rejects_every_transition_and_a_revision_is_dense`; `is_prunable('model')` is true past 50 and false for `requirement` at any depth.
- **Schema review.** Pass with two admitted findings. The 14 tables are §2.3/§2.4 column-for-column, with 14 FORCE RLS policies and no `CREATE TYPE`. The archive-exclusion statement over-reaches: only `card_board_list_position_idx` and `card_board_position_idx` carry `archived_at IS NULL`; `card_assignee_lease_idx` and `card_tsv_idx` include stamped cards, and later `card_name_trgm_idx` and `card_wbs_node_idx` add no predicate (v1-s03-2, P2).
- **Tenant isolation.** Pass. `rls_domain.rs::the_fourteen_domain_tables_isolate_runtime_owner_and_superuser`: runtime scoped to A sees no B rows; a forged `tenant_id=B` insert fails `WITH CHECK`; owner 0; superuser both.
- **Migrations.** Pass. A fresh database applies 2; the second run exits 0 with `_sqlx_migrations` unchanged; no `IF NOT EXISTS`; `migrate.rs` asserts `[(1,"platform"),(2,"domain")]`.
- **Card-state proof.** Pass. `information_schema.columns` for `card` and `(state,status)` returns zero rows; the `insta` snapshot pins `Card`'s field set; the word-boundary grep returns 0.

## Evidence

- Commit `96a3d47b0e43ef871ae42c0bfafac6a677f7a418` (2026-11-12T22:38:46+01:00), 'conveyor: public source snapshot (2026-11-12)' — `migrations/0002_domain.sql` (459 lines, 14 tables, 14 FORCE RLS), `crates/domain/src/board.rs` (629 lines), `crates/store/src/card.rs`, and `crates/store/tests/{claim_race,approval_race,transitions,rls_domain}.rs`.
- Published evidence document `01a1e686-d031-739d-ac30-9c0d4d8edffb` (2026-11-16T22:42:37Z, main@cc88052): 0/0 actions, 2/2 modules, 14/14 tables; inventory only, not an acceptance run.
- Project `01a1d039-0d28-743b-86c7-0d0698ed69c1`; programme `01a1d039-0d24-7d16-ae52-4841e96ccfac`; tranche 2 `01a1e9e0-e2ac-786b-ac48-3b8bcdf12188`.
- Accepted P0 issue `U3-EXC-S03` (`01a1fbac-8ec9-717c-be79-6d1b97980743`): 'Closed in an unauthorised tranche before the tranche review; accepted by the delegate as a retrospective exception under the standing delegation. The project is reworked in its batch and re-closed through the gates.'
- The snapshot's only tranche review is `01a1ed84-e111-7082-9fa8-7fe77ccc9024` (2026-11-18T07:17:50Z, decision `continue`) for tranche `01a1e9e0-ced2-7769-b12f-f6fba0997914`; no tranche-2 review exists.
- This rework records the charter, the Statement of Architecture Work, the delivery contract, the seven A–D artefacts, the scope baseline, the Phase-G review and this closure review; it declares the closure output `closure-review` and publishes the expected outputs `project-brief` and `evidence`.

## Open items

- **v1-s03-1 (P1, package owned by S03).** Either add a race of 32 distinct `app_user`s against one live lease and assert exactly one grant, or remove the same-assignee arm from `claim_card_tx`; restate property (b) to match the renewal semantics. A P1 does not block closure under this programme's manifest.
- **v1-s03-2 (P2, package owned by S03).** Restate the archive claim to name the two board-scan indexes and list the lease and search indexes that deliberately include stamped cards; add `archived_at IS NULL` only where exclusion is intended.
- **The run-tree amendment is later than the plan says.** The 2026-11-09 amendment places the tree in migration 0033; the repository settles it in `0037_run_tree_workflow_step.sql` around `parent_run_id` with `workflow_step_id` rather than the plan's `step_id`.
- **No contemporaneous schema-review record.** The plan requires a second reader against §2.3/§2.4; none exists at the snapshot. This retrospective review re-performs the check and admits the two findings.
- **Tranche 2 is `planned` and unauthorised** at the 2026-11-21T19:24:46Z snapshot (`authorised_at` null, `authorisation_review_id` null). The closure stands on the standing delegation and the accepted P0 exception U3-EXC-S03, not on a tranche-2 review.
- **No project-brief document existed**; this rework publishes it. The plan frontmatter remains `status: planned` although `meta.measured_status` is `built`.

## Decision

Record the compliance level **compliant** and close S03 under the standing delegation `01a1ff1f-e4ba-72dc-9c1a-13049933cf14` on the P0-only gate of `acceptance/programme/S03.toml`. The two admitted findings are packages owned by S03; a P1 is not a P0 and does not block closure. Re-close the project through the one gate with the closure output `closure-review` and the expected outputs `project-brief` and `evidence`, decided by an approver other than its requester. This is a retrospective record: it states the evidence that exists and does not claim a contemporaneous review that was never written.

- **Delivered:** the baseline domain in commit `96a3d47b0e43ef871ae42c0bfafac6a677f7a418` (2026-11-12T22:38:46+01:00), 'conveyor: public source snapshot (2026-11-12)' — `migrations/0002_domain.sql` (459 lines, 14 tables: programme, project, board, list, card_type, card, run, approval, approval_decision, governed_asset, trace_link, catalogue_entry, revision, andon_state; 14 FORCE RLS policies), `crates/domain` (the machines and `may_move`), `crates/store` (the `_tx` modules and `claim_card_tx`), and the gate tests in `claim_race.rs`, `approval_race.rs`, `transitions.rs`, `rls_domain.rs` plus the board proptests.
- **Measured evidence:** the published evidence document `01a1e686-d031-739d-ac30-9c0d4d8edffb` (2026-11-16T22:42:37Z, main@cc88052; 0/0 actions, 2/2 modules, 14/14 tables) and the named test functions in the repository. The evidence document records inventory only and does not re-run the acceptance suite.
- **Admitted findings:** v1-s03-1 (P1 — property (b) is overstated; the 32-racer test shares one user and one version and would pass with the lease arm deleted) and v1-s03-2 (P2 — the 'every hot index filters archived cards' claim is true only of the two board-scan indexes). Both are packages owned by S03; a P1 does not block closure, and this closure is on the P0-only gate.
- **Gap closed here:** the project had no Phase A–D artefacts, no Statement of Architecture Work, no delivery contract, no Phase-G review and no closure review; this rework publishes them, the charter, the project brief and the evidence page, and records the scope baseline against the one WBS deliverable.
- **Closure outputs declared:** `closure-review`. **Expected outputs:** `project-brief`, `evidence`.
- **Governance:** tranche 2 `01a1e9e0-e2ac-786b-ac48-3b8bcdf12188` is `planned` and unauthorised at the 2026-11-21T19:24:46Z snapshot; the accepted P0 issue `U3-EXC-S03` (`01a1fbac-8ec9-717c-be79-6d1b97980743`) records the out-of-sequence closure and the rework.
- **Decision:** re-close S03 against `acceptance/programme/S03.toml` on the P0-only gate, with the closure gate decided by an approver other than its requester, under the standing delegation `01a1ff1f-e4ba-72dc-9c1a-13049933cf14`.
- **Not recoverable:** no contemporaneous charter, Statement of Architecture Work, delivery contract, Phase-G review or closure review was authored; this closure is retrospective and does not attest contemporaneous intent.
